info_server.en: The server you're signed in to. Signing out keeps your downloads; they come back when you sign in to the same account.

info_wifi_quality.en: How songs are sent when you're on Wi-Fi. Original plays the file as it is on your server, so FLAC stays lossless; a number asks the server to convert to MP3 at that bitrate, which uses less data but can't sound better than the original.
info_wifi_quality.comment: Explanation (i) of Streaming quality on Wi-Fi

info_mobile_quality.en: The same choice for when you're on mobile data. A lower bitrate saves your data plan and starts faster on a weak signal.
info_mobile_quality.comment: Explanation (i) of Streaming quality on mobile data

info_download_quality.en: How songs are saved for offline listening. Original keeps the exact file from your server and takes the most space; 320 or 192 asks the server to convert to MP3, which can make a FLAC album several times smaller.

info_download_mobile.en: When this is off, downloads wait for Wi-Fi and start again by themselves once you're connected.
info_download_mobile.comment: Explanation (i) of Download over mobile data

info_resume.en: If music was playing when the app was closed, start it again right away when you open the app. When this is off, the player opens where you left off, paused, so one tap continues.
info_resume.comment: Explanation (i) of Resume playing on open

info_offline_mode.en: Use only what's downloaded and never contact the server. The app also switches to this by itself whenever your server can't be reached, for example when Tailscale is off.

info_scrobble.en: Tell your server what you listen to, so Recently played and Most played stay accurate and play counts go up. Plays made offline are sent once you're back online.
info_scrobble.comment: Explanation (i) of Report plays to server

info_cache.en: Album covers and library pages kept on your phone so screens open instantly and you can browse offline. Clearing it is safe; it fills up again as you browse.

info_downloads.en: Songs saved for offline listening. Removing them frees the space; you can download them again any time.

info_about.en: Spinwell is a free, open source player for your own Navidrome or OpenSubsonic server. No ads, no analytics.
